firstUse.quote: An objectophile derives feelings of love, sexual attraction, and gratification from things rather than people and can't imagine having that kind of relationship with a live human being.
firstUse.source: 2009, Cynthia Ceilán, Weirdly Beloved: Tales of Strange Bedfellows, Odd Couplings, and Love Gone Bad, Guilford, Conn.: Lyons Press, page 56:
